pairs.target: xiāngzǐ yǒu liǎngzhī bǎshǒu , nài lěi què bùxǔ tǎ wéi xiān tí .
pairs.english: The box had two handles, but Nerai would not let Tavi lift it yet.
pairs.hanzi: 箱子有两只把手，奈蕾却不许塔维先提。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi lǐmiàn zhuāng zhe bùnéng huàng de dōngxī , shǒu xuán zhe méi gǎndòng .
pairs.english: He thought something inside must not be shaken, and held his hand suspended, not daring to move.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为里面装着不能晃的东西，手悬着没敢动。

pairs.target: tā dūnxiàqù , cóng xiāngdǐ chōuchū yìzhī xié , shuō shuí zài bǎ xié sāi zài zhuōxià , tā jiù zhuāngxiāng dàizǒu .
pairs.english: She crouched, pulled a shoe from under the box, and said anyone who stuffed shoes under the table again would have them packed and taken away.
pairs.hanzi: 她蹲下去，从箱底抽出一只鞋，说谁再把鞋塞在桌下，她就装箱带走。

pairs.target: pángbiān nàge juàn shéng de nánrén shēnjiǎo lái gòu , gòu búdào , zhōngyú fàngxià shéngzi .
pairs.english: The man coiling rope beside them stretched a foot toward it, failed to reach, and finally put his rope down.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边那个卷绳的男人伸脚来够，够不到，终于放下绳子。

pairs.target: tā xiào zhe shuō shǎo dài yìzhī zhènghǎo jiǎnzhòng , lìngyìzhī kěyǐ lúnliú chuān .
pairs.english: Laughing, he said taking one fewer shoe would save weight; they could take turns wearing the other.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑着说少带一只正好减重，另一只可以轮流穿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái fāxiàn xiāngzǐ háishì kōng de .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi realize the box was still empty.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才发现箱子还是空的。

pairs.target: tiān fàngqíng le , běi gōng fánglǐ yíbàn zhuōmiàn bèi tàiyáng zhàozhe .
pairs.english: The sky had cleared, and sunlight covered half the tables in the north workshop.
pairs.hanzi: 天放晴了，北工房里一半桌面被太阳照着。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ lái bāngmáng de liùmíng xuéshēng fēn dào liǎngbiān , yìbiān zuò ruǎn bùtào ,
pairs.english: Instructor Vey divided the six student helpers into two groups: one made soft cloth sleeves,
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把来帮忙的六名学生分到两边，一边做软布套，

pairs.target: yìbiān zhěnglǐ yǐjīng diǎn guò de qìjù .
pairs.english: while the other sorted equipment that had already been counted.
pairs.hanzi: 一边整理已经点过的器具。

pairs.target: chūfā dìng zài hòutiān ,
pairs.english: Departure was set for the day after tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 出发定在后天，

pairs.target: jīntiān zhuāng hǎo háiyào guò yíyè , zài chá yǒuméiyǒu lòu dài hé shòucháo .
pairs.english: Once packed today, the gear would sit overnight and then be checked again for anything missing or damp.
pairs.hanzi: 今天装好还要过一夜，再查有没有漏带和受潮。

pairs.target: mǐlā nádào yíkuài bù hé yìpái zhǎngduǎnbùqí de gānzi , méiyǒu jí zhe xià jiǎn .
pairs.english: Given a piece of cloth and a row of rods of different lengths, Mira did not hurry to cut.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉拿到一块布和一排长短不齐的杆子，没有急着下剪。

pairs.target: tā xiān wèn zhè shì dào dìfāng cái quán qǔchū lái , háishì lùshang zhī ná yìgēn .
pairs.english: First she asked whether they would take them all out at their destination, or just one along the way.
pairs.hanzi: 她先问这是到地方才全取出来，还是路上只拿一根。

pairs.target: nánrén shuō chángcháng zhǐyào zuì duǎn de nàgēn , tā biàn bǎ nàgēn dāndú fàngdào zuì wàicè .
pairs.english: The man said they often needed only the shortest, so she placed that one separately on the outside.
pairs.hanzi: 男人说常常只要最短的那根，她便把那根单独放到最外侧。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fēn dào de xiǎohé lǐ shì liǎngtào tánhuáng zhǐshìqì , gùdìng zài mù zuò shàng , xì zhēn páng gè yǒu yídào zhǎi kèdù .
pairs.english: Tavi's small box held two spring indicators fixed to wooden bases, with narrow scales beside their fine pointers.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维分到的小盒里是两套弹簧指示器，固定在木座上，细针旁各有一道窄刻度。

pairs.target: tāmen néng bǐjiào xiǎo fùzài , búshì wǎng qiáo shàng yí fàng jiù néng zhīdào zhěngzuò qiáo hǎohuài de dōngxī .
pairs.english: They could compare small loads; they weren't something you put on a bridge to discover whether the whole bridge was sound.
pairs.hanzi: 它们能比较小负载，不是往桥上一放就能知道整座桥好坏的东西。

alignment.english: whether the whole bridge was sound

pairs.target: dà xiē de liángjù hái zài lìng yìjiān wūlǐ , jīntiān lúnbúdào xuéshēng dòng .
pairs.english: Larger measuring instruments were still in another room, and students would not handle those today.
pairs.hanzi: 大些的量具还在另一间屋里，今天轮不到学生动。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī nálái tāmen yòng guò de fǎmǎ , ràng tā hé luò héng xiān kàn qìjù yuánlái huí bu huí líng .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey brought the weights they had used before and told him and Lohen to check first whether the instruments returned to zero in their unmodified state.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师拿来他们用过的砝码，让他和洛衡先看器具原来回不回零。

alignment.english: whether the instruments returned to zero

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū qízhōng yítào de zhēnjiǎo yǒudiǎn sōng , zhuǎntóu zhǎo lǎoshī , méiyǒu shēnshǒu bān .
pairs.english: Tavi noticed one pointer's mounting was slightly loose and turned to find the teacher without trying to bend it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认出其中一套的针脚有点松，转头找老师，没有伸手扳。

pairs.target: lǎoshī shōuzǒu nà tào , lìng gěi tā yítào yǐjīng tiáo hǎo de .
pairs.english: She took that set away and gave him another that had already been adjusted.
pairs.hanzi: 老师收走那套，另给他一套已经调好的。

pairs.target: shèngxià de bùzhòu tā shúxī , què bǐ zài kèzhuō qián màn .
pairs.english: He knew the remaining steps, yet worked more slowly than at his classroom desk.
pairs.hanzi: 剩下的步骤他熟悉，却比在课桌前慢。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhīdào zhèxiē dōngxī huì bèi dàizǒu , búhuì zài xiàkè yǐhòu suíbiàn liúzài yuándì .
pairs.english: Tavi knew these things would be taken away, not simply left where they were after class.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维知道这些东西会被带走，不会在下课以后随便留在原地。

pairs.target: tā bǎ fǎmǎ fàng huí pán lǐ shí , zhǐjiān dōu pà nòng chū tài dà shēngyīn .
pairs.english: Even as he put the weights back in the tray, his fingertips seemed afraid of making too much noise.
pairs.hanzi: 他把砝码放回盘里时，指尖都怕弄出太大声音。

pairs.target: luò héng wèn tā shìbushì děng zhe fǎmǎ shuìzháo ,
pairs.english: Lohen asked whether he was waiting for the weights to fall asleep.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡问他是不是等着砝码睡着，

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō bié cuī , zuǐ shàng zhèyàng shuō , jiānbǎng dǎo sōng le xiē .
pairs.english: Tavi said not to rush him, but despite his words his shoulders relaxed a little.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说别催，嘴上这样说，肩膀倒松了些。

pairs.target: lǎoshī fàng hǎo guīdìng de xiǎo fùzài , jiào tā yòng jiēchù shí de jiè xìng bǎ liǎngtào de chābié fàng qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: The teacher set the specified light loads in place and asked him to use borrowing while in contact to make the difference between the two instruments clearer.
pairs.hanzi: 老师放好规定的小负载，叫他用接触时的借性把两套的差别放清楚。

pairs.target: liǎngkuài tiěpiàn de liáng hé zhī fǎ dōu hé guò , shǒuxià réng shì shúxī de dàxiǎo .
pairs.english: The volumes and supports of both iron plates had been checked, and their size beneath his hands was still familiar.
pairs.hanzi: 两块铁片的量和支法都核过，手下仍是熟悉的大小。

pairs.target: tā àn kè lǐ liàn guò de fúdù jiēshàng biànhuà , luò héng cóng tóng yíchù kàn zhēn , bàochū wèizhì .
pairs.english: He linked the changes to the degree practiced in class, while Lohen read the pointers from the same position and reported their locations.
pairs.hanzi: 他按课里练过的幅度接上变化，洛衡从同一处看针，报出位置。

pairs.target: tíngxià , xiē yíhuìer , zài kàn huīfù .
pairs.english: Stop, rest a while, then check the return.
pairs.hanzi: 停下、歇一会儿，再看恢复。

pairs.target: shùzhí luò zài lǎoshī gěi de fànwéi lǐ .
pairs.english: The readings fell within the range the teacher had given.
pairs.hanzi: 数值落在老师给的范围里。

pairs.target: luò héng bǎ zhǐ jiāoguòqù shí , tǎ wéi xiǎng shuō liú chí de shì , yòu méi shuō .
pairs.english: As Lohen handed over the paper, Tavi wanted to mention retention after release, then didn't.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡把纸交过去时，塔维想说留持的事，又没说。

pairs.target: tā xiànzài gèng xiǎng zhīdào , zhège hézi dào le hébiān huì bèi shuí dǎkāi .
pairs.english: What he wanted to know more now was who would open this box at the river.
pairs.hanzi: 他现在更想知道，这个盒子到了河边会被谁打开。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō duōbàn shì gāngcái zhǎo xié de rén .
pairs.english: Nerai said it would probably be the man who had been looking for his shoe.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说多半是刚才找鞋的人。

pairs.target: nà rén xìng hè , qùguò běi chà liǎnghuí ,
pairs.english: His surname was He. He had been to Northfork twice,
pairs.hanzi: 那人姓贺，去过北汊两回，

pairs.target: quèshuō měi huí shāzhōu dōu xiàng bān guò jiā , wǎngnián de tú zhǐnéng xiān dài zhe , dào le hái dé kàn .
pairs.english: but said the sandbars seemed to have moved house every time: old maps were worth bringing, but things still had to be checked on arrival.
pairs.hanzi: 却说每回沙洲都像搬过家，往年的图只能先带着，到了还得看。

pairs.target: hè shīfu guòlái shōu hé , kàn le yíbiàn zhǐ , bǎ liǎng rén de míngzì niàn duì , wèn shuí zì xiě dé xiǎo .
pairs.english: Master He came to collect the box, read the paper, pronounced both their names correctly, and asked who wrote the small letters.
pairs.hanzi: 贺师傅过来收盒，看了一遍纸，把两人的名字念对，问谁字写得小。

pairs.target: luò héng jǔshǒu , tā shuō nà qǐng zài xiě dà yìdiǎn , yǔtiān yǎnjīng yě bùtīngshǐhuàn .
pairs.english: Lohen raised his hand. He asked him to make them larger: eyes didn't always cooperate in rain.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡举手，他说那请再写大一点，雨天眼睛也不听使唤。

pairs.target: gé zhuō yǒu yìméi jiá kòukòu bú shàng .
pairs.english: At the next table, a clip would not fasten.
pairs.hanzi: 隔桌有一枚夹扣扣不上。

pairs.target: tā jiá de shì pán shéng mùjià shàng de pídài , kòu kǒu zhǎi , dé yònglì bāikāi cáinéng yuèguò pídài biān .
pairs.english: It held a leather strap on the rope-reel frame; its narrow opening had to be forced apart to pass over the strap's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 它夹的是盘绳木架上的皮带，扣口窄，得用力掰开才能越过皮带边。

pairs.target: nài lěi jiào hè shīfu xiān bié yìng bāi ,
pairs.english: Nerai told Master He not to force it yet.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾叫贺师傅先别硬掰，

pairs.target: bǎ kòuzǐ qǔ xiàlái , hé yípiàn zǎo pèi hǎo de tiětiáo píng fàngzài diànbǎn shàng .
pairs.english: She removed the clip and laid it flat on a backing board beside an iron strip matched to it earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 把扣子取下来，和一片早配好的铁条平放在垫板上。

pairs.target: tā jiào tǎ wéi kàn , zuǒyòushǒu gè tiē yíjiàn .
pairs.english: She told Tavi to watch, touching one piece with each hand.
pairs.hanzi: 她叫塔维看，左右手各贴一件。

pairs.target: kòuzǐ de báo bì zài hè shīfu shǒulǐ de xiǎo qián xià wān kāi ,
pairs.english: The thin arms of the clip bent apart beneath Master He's little pliers,
pairs.hanzi: 扣子的薄臂在贺师傅手里的小钳下弯开，

pairs.target: tiětiáo zài lìngyìbiān de xiǎo pèizhòng xià biànde gèng bùkěn xià wān .
pairs.english: while the iron strip on the other side became more reluctant to bend beneath its small counterweight.
pairs.hanzi: 铁条在另一边的小配重下变得更不肯下弯。

pairs.target: pídài fàngjìn yǐhòu , tā xiān tuìhuí biànhuà , zài lí shǒu .
pairs.english: After the strap was placed inside, she reversed the change before taking her hands away.
pairs.hanzi: 皮带放进以后，她先退回变化，再离手。

pairs.target: jiá kòu tánhuí yuánwèi , kòuzhù le pídài .
pairs.english: The clip sprang back into place, fastening around the strap.
pairs.hanzi: 夹扣弹回原位，扣住了皮带。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi còujìn kàn nà dào kǒuzǐ , méiyǒu biànkuān , yě méiyǒu liúxià xīn de wān hén .
pairs.english: Tavi leaned closer to look at the opening: it had not widened, nor were there any new bend marks.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维凑近看那道口子，没有变宽，也没有留下新的弯痕。

pairs.target: hè shīfu lā le liǎngxià , cái bǎ mùjià dìgěi zuò bùtào de rén .
pairs.english: Master He tugged twice before passing the frame to the people making sleeves.
pairs.hanzi: 贺师傅拉了两下，才把木架递给做布套的人。

pairs.target: " wèishénme bù zhíjiē huàn gè kuān de ? " mǐlā wèn .
pairs.english: “Why not simply use a wider one?” Mira asked.
pairs.hanzi: “为什么不直接换个宽的？”米拉问。

pairs.target: hè shīfu bǎ jiàzi cè guòlái , gěi tā kàn cáokǒu páng móliàng de yíkuài .
pairs.english: Master He turned the frame sideways and showed her a polished patch beside the slot.
pairs.hanzi: 贺师傅把架子侧过来，给她看槽口旁磨亮的一块。

pairs.target: kuān kòuzǐ zài zhèlǐ huì cèng , juàn shéng de shíhòu hái guāguò rénshǒu .
pairs.english: A wide clip rubbed there, and had scratched someone's hand while winding rope.
pairs.hanzi: 宽扣子在这里会蹭，卷绳的时候还刮过人手。

pairs.target: tā dài guò yìhuí , huílái jiù huàn le .
pairs.english: He had taken one once and replaced it on his return.
pairs.hanzi: 他带过一回，回来就换了。

pairs.target: mǐlā yòng mǔzhǐ bǐ le bǐ , méiyǒu zài wèn .
pairs.english: Mira measured it with her thumb without asking anything else.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉用拇指比了比，没有再问。

pairs.target: tā huídào zìjǐ de bù shàng , bǎ liúgěi kòuzǐ de kǒuzǐ yòu fàngkuān le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Returning to her cloth, she widened the opening left for the clip a little more.
pairs.hanzi: 她回到自己的布上，把留给扣子的口子又放宽了一点。

pairs.target: kuài dào wǔfàn shí , yīwén gēnzhe sòng tú de wénshū jìnlái .
pairs.english: Toward lunch, Iven followed the clerk delivering maps inside.
pairs.hanzi: 快到午饭时，伊文跟着送图的文书进来。

pairs.target: tā bào de shì kōng zhǐtǒng , yǐjīng héqiān de tú yóu wénshū ná zhe .
pairs.english: He carried an empty paper tube; the checked and signed map was in the clerk's hands.
pairs.hanzi: 他抱的是空纸筒，已经核签的图由文书拿着。

pairs.target: shàng huí nàzhǒng jiàodà de zì liúxià le ,
pairs.english: The larger lettering from last time remained,
pairs.hanzi: 上回那种较大的字留下了，

pairs.target: jūmín tōngxíng hé huòchē wèi hé de shuōmíng yě zài ,
pairs.english: as did the note about resident use and unverified freight carts.
pairs.hanzi: 居民通行和货车未核的说明也在，

pairs.target: dìsāngè qiáomíng réng dānliè zhe , méiyǒu yìng fàngjìn héwān lǐ .
pairs.english: The third bridge name was still listed separately, not forced into a spot in the river bend.
pairs.hanzi: 第三个桥名仍单列着，没有硬放进河湾里。

pairs.target: nài lěi tān tú shí , yīwén shēnshǒu yāzhù yìjiǎo , zhǐ gěi tā kàn gǎiguò de wèizhì .
pairs.english: As Nerai spread the map out, Iven held down a corner and pointed out the altered locations.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾摊图时，伊文伸手压住一角，指给她看改过的位置。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shǒuzhǐ shùnzhe nàtiáo xìxiàn yíchūqù , tíng zài zhǐbiān .
pairs.english: She ran a finger along the fine line until it stopped at the paper's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 她把手指顺着那条细线移出去，停在纸边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi nuó guòqù , fāxiàn xiàn hái méiyǒu huà wán , xià yìzhāng tú yǐjīng jiēshàng .
pairs.english: Tavi moved closer and saw that the line had not ended; the next map was already being joined on.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维挪过去，发现线还没有画完，下一张图已经接上。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài liǎngzhāng zhǐ de jiēfèng qián ,
pairs.english: Standing before the join between the two sheets,
pairs.hanzi: 他站在两张纸的接缝前，

pairs.target: hūrán juéde nà jiān huì wūlǐ zhēng de lù , bǐ zhuōzi dàdéduō .
pairs.english: he suddenly felt that the route they argued over in the meeting house was far larger than the table.
pairs.hanzi: 忽然觉得那间会屋里争的路，比桌子大得多。

pairs.target: hè shīfu shuō hébiān háiyǒu yìjiā mài rè bǐng de ,
pairs.english: Master He said there was also a stall selling hot flatbread by the river.
pairs.hanzi: 贺师傅说河边还有一家卖热饼的，

pairs.target: ruò zhèhuí tānzi méibān , tā dàiduì lǐ de rén qù .
pairs.english: If the stall hadn't moved this time, he would take the team there.
pairs.hanzi: 若这回摊子没搬，他带队里的人去。

pairs.target: wénshū shuō xiān rènzhǔn shì zìjǐ rén , bùrán bié bǎ rénjiā de yuànmén yòu dāng lùkǒu .
pairs.english: The clerk said to make sure it was the right people first, instead of mistaking someone's courtyard gate for a junction again.
pairs.hanzi: 文书说先认准是自己人，不然别把人家的院门又当路口。

pairs.target: xiàoshēng lǐ , tǎ wéi bǎ yǐ tào hǎo de xiǎohé fàngjìn xiāng jiǎo .
pairs.english: Amid the laughter, Tavi placed the sleeved small box in a corner of the crate.
pairs.hanzi: 笑声里，塔维把已套好的小盒放进箱角。

pairs.target: nài lěi lái fú lìngyìzhī bǎshǒu , zhèhuí cái jiào tā yìqǐ tái dào ménbiān .
pairs.english: Nerai took the other handle; this time she asked him to carry it with her to the doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾来扶另一只把手，这回才叫他一起抬到门边。

pairs.target: xiāngzǐ yā shǒu , liǎnggè rén zǒu dé hěn màn , guò ménkǎn shí dōu tíng le yíxià .
pairs.english: The box weighed on their hands; they walked very slowly, both pausing at the threshold.
pairs.hanzi: 箱子压手，两个人走得很慢，过门槛时都停了一下。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ háiyào shàngkè .
pairs.english: There were still classes that afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 下午还要上课。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xǐ qù shǒushàng de hēi yìn , huílái qǔ běnzi ,
pairs.english: Tavi washed the black marks from his hands and came back for his notebook.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维洗去手上的黑印，回来取本子，

pairs.target: kànjiàn mǐlā zài qiáo zuò tú páng huà le yígè xiǎoxiǎode kòuzǐ .
pairs.english: He saw that Mira had drawn a tiny clip beside her bridge-bearing drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 看见米拉在桥座图旁画了一个小小的扣子。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zìjǐ de dèngzǐ tuō guòqù , shuō cè dǎng hái chà zuìhòu yì jié , yào buyào xiànzài liáng .
pairs.english: He pulled his stool over and said the side guide still lacked its last section; did she want to measure it now?
pairs.hanzi: 他把自己的凳子拖过去，说侧挡还差最后一截，要不要现在量。
